title: AIrth – AI for Energy Efficiency and Emissions Reduction
summary: AIrth has tested an energy-insight prototype with simulated data and plans pilots with Georgian businesses and households.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The prototype combines AI and connected-device information to identify ways to use energy more efficiently. Its current tests use simulated data. Pilots with businesses and households are planned, along with real-world data collection and appliance integration. The described energy and emissions benefits therefore remain prospective.
purpose: Help businesses and households understand and reduce energy use.

data.answer:
AIrth has tested an energy-insight prototype with simulated data and plans pilots with Georgian businesses and households.

Planned SME and household pilots do not demonstrate lower bills or emissions. Forecasting accuracy, adherence to recommendations, baseline consumption, and the energy cost of operating the service are not evaluated in the entry. A carbon marketplace connection is not proof of additional emissions avoided.

The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.
